Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 137. Category: technique. Rank 1.

Rank 1 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 10
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 60 feet
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Blast
Fire one explosive energy shot at a target. The
choosen target must make a dexterity saving throw or
take 3d10 ki damage, half on a save.
